premerge_revert: git revert <A9 commits> then git revert <A8-to-A1 commits selectively if required>
postmerge_rollback: Use the repository protected revert workflow against the merged SHA; do not flush Redis.
rollback_trigger: health, authorization, cache-correctness, Range, body-leak, or stale-response regression
cold_cache_behavior: source-of-truth fallback with natural legacy-key expiry
